summary: Iteration 5 mural 30-day auto-expiry: extended backend_test.py with TestMuralExpiry (6 new cases) and updated TestMural pricing assertion for display_days=30. Full regression suite of 55 tests passes (100%). All review_request bullets verified end-to-end against REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/mural.py /extend endpoint correctly clamps days via max(1, days) so days<=0 still produces ~1-day expiry (verified for days=0 and days=-5).
approve and extend both return the freshly fetched document with {_id:0} projection -> no ObjectId leaks (verified across all mural responses).
GET /api/mural default include_expired=false properly excludes expired (expires_at < now) AND null-expires_at messages are kept visible via the $or {expires_at: None}/{expires_at: {$gt: now}} clause.

Minor consideration (not a bug): /extend silently allows extending a non-approved (paid=false, approved=false) message - it sets expires_at on a message that won't show publicly anyway. Consider gating /extend on approved=true or document the intent.
Minor: MURAL_DISPLAY_DAYS default on /extend (days=MURAL_DISPLAY_DAYS=30) makes PUT /api/mural/{id}/extend without query param a 30-day reset - good UX, just worth surfacing in API docs.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed mural messages and clean up via DELETE /api/mural/{id} after each case. Backdating done via direct pymongo update on db.mural_messages.
context_for_next_testing_agent: TestMuralExpiry uses pymongo (sync) with MONGO_URL+DB_NAME from backend/.env to backdate expires_at. All approval/extend timing checks tolerate 0.5s skew (29.5-30.1 days, 0.9-1.1 days, etc.). If you add new mural endpoints, extend TestMuralExpiry and keep the _assert_no_objectid sweep at the end.
rca of the issue: N/A - no defects found. Iteration 5 implementation matches spec: pending creation -> expires_at=null; approve -> expires_at=now+30d; public list filters expired; include_expired=true returns all; /extend admin-guarded with day clamping >=1; pricing config exposes display_days=30; no ObjectId leaks anywhere in mural responses.
